children: Saha, currently Whole-time Director at Kotak Mahindra Bank, will take over as Managing Director & CEO for a three-year term from January 1, 2027

The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) approves the appointment of Anup Kumar Saha as Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer (MD & CEO) of Kotak Mahindra Bank for a three-year term, effective January 1, 2027.

Saha currently serves as Whole-time Director and Executive Director at Kotak Mahindra Bank. He joins the bank in January 2026 and has overseen its Retail Bank, Data Analytics and Marketing functions since March 2026.

C. S. Rajan, Chairman, Kotak Mahindra Bank, welcomes the RBI’s approval and says Saha brings extensive experience across banking and financial services. He adds that Saha’s leadership will focus on strengthening the bank’s franchise and pursuing sustainable growth.

Ashok Vaswani, Managing Director & CEO, Kotak Mahindra Bank, says Saha has experience across businesses, customer segments and operating functions. He adds that Saha has developed an understanding of the opportunities ahead since joining the bank and will focus on strengthening customer relationships and building on Kotak’s existing foundations.

Saha says he is grateful to the Board for its confidence and looks forward to leading the bank. He says his priorities include deepening customer relationships, executing consistently and creating sustainable value for shareholders and stakeholders.

Saha brings more than 32 years of professional experience, including 25 years across financial services, banking and non-banking financial institutions. Before joining Kotak Mahindra Bank, he holds senior leadership positions at Bajaj Finance, where he eventually serves as Managing Director & CEO.

Earlier, Saha spends 14 years at ICICI Bank, leading businesses and functions including Retail Secured Assets, Business Intelligence, Retail and Rural Collections, Credit Cards and Retail Structured Finance. He begins his career with GE Capital, working across credit cards, sales and analytics, and later works with Bharat Heavy Electricals Limited in production engineering.
Saha holds a B.Tech degree in Engineering from IIT Kharagpur and an MBA from IIM Lucknow.
The Board of Kotak Mahindra Bank will take further steps to formalise the appointment and seek members’ approval.
